Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the approved DeepSeek short-sleeve sports uniform and identity. Keep cobalt-to-cyan long wavy hair, loop ahoge, blue eyes, white fin ears, cyan bow and blue whale tail. Outfit: ivory zip-front short-sleeve track top with stand collar, navy blue panels and track pants, cobalt piping, small whale emblem, matching full-length track pants with ivory side stripes and white sneakers. SHORT sleeves above elbows, natural bare forearms, modest comfortable fit; no skirt, apron, dress, stockings or high heels. Crisp anime chibi illustration, huge round head and eyes, tiny short body and limbs, matching the approved blue-haired chibi sports reference proportions.
Asset type: production sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns by 6 rows, 24 isolated full-body poses ordered row-major. Portrait canvas, clean transparent alpha. Each character fits in the central 75% of its cell, full hair hands and shoes visible, large clean empty gutters; no connecting shadows. Same anatomical scale/head size in ALL cells, do not resize curled/sleeping characters to fill their cell. Front view except as required. No labels, borders, words, ground, aura, effects or extra objects except the small toy mallet described below.
Row 1: (0) neutral standing, feet parallel slightly apart, arms hanging slightly away from body and straight with open hands; (1) friendly speaking with small mouth opening and open palm at waist; (2) quietly thinking, lips CLOSED, fingertips to chin; (3) headpat response slight forward head tilt and soft closed smile.
Row 2: (4) headpat response eyes closed deeper gentle head dip; (5) one cheek softly squished, head tilts left; (6) other cheek softly squished head tilts right; (7) tickle startled shoulders rising, hands near ribs.
Row 3: (8) tickle giggling eyes closed shoulders up arms protecting waist; (9) jump anticipation bending knees slightly; (10) airborne jump knees tucked and arms opened, no ground FX; (11) landing knee bend arms balanced.
Row 4: (12) sitting down knees forward; (13) fully sitting hugging both knees close to chest, face resting above knees; (14) lying on side resting head on hands, eyes drowsy; (15) same lying pose fully asleep eyes closed.
Row 5: (16) lifted gently upright, shoulders up, arms relaxed, toes pointing downward, no giant hand; (17) same lifted pose legs gently bent, NOT swinging; (18) catching ready, BOTH forearms pointing forward, cupped palms close together at lower chest; (19) catch impact, same hands slightly drawn back at upper stomach, no ball painted.
Row 6: (20) holding imaginary ball in palms at waist, no ball painted; (21) missed catch looking off to right, arms lowering; (22) small pastel toy mallet held over OWN head, body upright; (23) mallet gently resting on own head, eyes squinting, head tipped slightly down. The mallet is connected to the hand by its handle and identical in both frames.
Clean consistent artwork with distinct natural body poses, no extra human hands. Arms/forearms visible below SHORT sleeves in every pose.
Remove ALL backdrop/glow from the reference; background completely transparent outside silhouettes.
